answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a falcon tag. The velvet cap is enforced at intake and marble shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. A farm of 71 pays that 153 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
